subject: Vehicle Variety
author: matto04
body: I forgot to put it in my blog, but I also think that there should be more ( not saying that there isn't ) variety of the cars that they use. I think EA could have added more cars with different variety, but I think that they wanted to focus most on ( since this is EA's first Burnout Roaming game ) the maps and the physical features of the surrounding area, so that their first game like this would be mind boggling and explosive.

subject: Alternative Vehicles in Burnout
author: ZombieTron
body:
I agree, I don't think Planes or Bikes work in Burnout, which is why the bikes in Paradise are just that... not Burnout on Bikes.

I would love to see more variety of vehicles used tho! I used to love using the Heavy Weights for Crash Mode and always wondered what a Fire Truck race on Burnout 3 would be like!!

I also always wanted to race with Tuk Tuk's!! And I always loved that you started with compact cars and worked your way up to super cars! The learner driver car is still one of my favourite cars in the Burnout series!! 🚗 👍 ✈️ 👎 😃
